services.desc: Brazilian Jiu-Jitsu is a predominantly ground-based martial art, using the principals of leverage, angles, pressure and timing, as well as knowledge of the human anatomy, in order to achieve a non-violent submission of one’s opponent. Unlike other martial arts that focus on strikes and/or kicks, jiujitsu focuses on close-contact “grappling” holds and techniques, and the application of chokes and joint-manipulations. Discover the path to a healthier you! Martial arts training improves your fitness, strength, flexibility and cardiovascular health, helping you achieve your wellness goals with energy and enthusiam. Empower yourself with essential life skills! Martial arts equips individuals
